shared_elements: profile animal/avian forms or feathered forms
justification: The most specific overlap is that both are carved vertical stone surfaces using relief/linear carving and include anthropomorphic body parts, with A showing a full standing winged human-like figure and B showing more schematic arms/hands and animals arranged in registers. The biggest difference is compositional: A is dominated by one large, carefully modeled figure in profile, while B is an irregular pillar face covered with separate, rougher animal and sign-like motifs in stacked zones.
